verdict.rationale: Metronome documents webhooks that fire when a threshold is reached, and markets a customizable in-product billing dashboard for customers, so thresholds, alerts and customer-facing visibility are its own capabilities. The evidence never explicitly shows real-time current-cycle usage and accrued-cost views for the team or customers. The dashboard claim is truncated, and data-warehouse export is only a building block. Missing for 10: explicit docs on real-time current-period usage and accrued-cost display, configurable alert thresholds for spend or usage, detail on what the customer-facing dashboard shows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone

citations.quote: Metronome sends an HTTP POST request to that URL when certain events occur, such as a contract being created, a threshold being reached or an invoice being finalized.
